text:
arjun: rolled an RBAC tighten (keystore access scope) in ap-south during the 02:30 maintenance window. now seeing mtls handshake failures and proxy 5xx spikes. any KMS decrypt denies?

maria: noticed handshake fail spike ~02:38, attaching quick log snippet and alert link — https://logs.internal/redwood/ap-south ?ctx=handshake

devon: oncall here, pulling traces and pprof. grabbing pod list now.

rebecca: quick check of audit stream: KMS:Decrypt denied entries for svcacct 'redwood-proxy' between 02:38-02:42. also a rolebinding change recorded 02:35.

sre-bot: alert: mtls-handshake-failure-rate > 5% in ap-south (02:39). incident channel notified.

arjun: pasted relevant snippet from proxy logs / audit (sanitized):

```
proxy.ERROR: tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
k8s.audit: RoleBinding "keystore-client-role-binding" removed subject svcaccount:redwood-proxy
kms.ERROR: AccessDenied: arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:123456789012:key/abcd... Decrypt denied for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-role
```

maria: sounds like the RBAC change removed an unwrap/keystore permission proxies expected. the PR replaced broad keystore:unwrap with a narrower decrypt-only; but we use envelope keys which require unwrap.

devon: mitigation — initiating rollback of the RBAC change now: `git revert 9f3a2b1 && ./deploy rollback --region=ap-south` ETA ~6m. will follow up once deploy bot reports.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback started (region=ap-south) id=d-98321 user=devon ETA=6m

rebecca: root cause hypothesis: privilege pruning removed keystore unwrap from the proxy service account; proxies then couldn't unwrap data keys causing handshake termination when fetching cert material from keystore.

arjun: confirms — envelope key flow requires UnwrapKey on KMS or keystore unwrap permission. our RBAC mapping conflated Decrypt with Unwrap.

maria: suggested fixes: add a compatibility shim in RBAC change that maps required keystore actions for proxies, add post-deploy canary that performs an mtls handshake check, and alert on KMS:DecryptDenied and KMS:UnwrapDenied metrics.

devon: triage notes: not a CVE but a config/regression risk. put this into vulnerability-process as a "misconfiguration" class; recommend preflight tests in CI.

security-bot: created incident INC-987 with labels [rbac, kms, mtls, ap-south] assigned to @rebecca.

rebecca: opened PR today to restore minimal Unwrap scope + unit/integration test that runs a synthetic mtls handshake via the keystore. pinging @devex for adding a lightweight integration test to the quickstart.

arjun: after rollback traffic and handshake metrics returned to baseline (02:49). good. next steps: 1) restore role with Unwrap, 2) update RBAC PR with explicit keystore action mapping and integration test, 3) add audit alert for KMS deny spikes, 4) add runbook section for RBAC keystore changes.

maria: I'll add the audit rule and a Grafana panel for KMS:DecryptDenied & KMS:UnwrapDenied. also increase audit retention for keystore events to 90 days for postmortem.

devon: sgtm. I'll update the deploy playbook so RBAC keystore changes require a canary deploy and an mtls health check step.

arjun: quick note — we should also check other regions for the same RBAC PR; schedule a cross-region audit. maybe a script to diff rolebindings across clusters.

rebecca: +1. will run a rolebinding diff across prod clusters and post results.

maria: thumbs up :thumbsup:

devon: closing oncall handoff, will watch metrics for the next 1h. :eyes:

sre-bot: alert cleared: mtls-handshake-failure-rate back to baseline (02:49).

security-bot: incident INC-987 updated: state=mitigated, next=postmortem + RBAC policy update.

arjun: thanks all — filing a short postmortem draft and linking PRs. any other blockers?

maria: none from security side.

devon: none, monitoring.

rebecca: will send PR link in the incident and mark for review.

arjun: ok marking done. good catch on the unwrap/decrypt distinction — lesson: narrower scopes still need explicit test coverage.
